independence: Fixed expected outcomes and separate process/model implementation, not organizationally independent QA or another agent.
modelLimitations: No cryptography/TLS handshake/HBA parser/OS ACL implementation is modeled or tested.
Catalog grant closure and absence of privileged functions/jobs are supplied preconditions, not extracted from a real database.
Static misconfiguration cases validate fail-closed decision rules; they do not certify actual container or database configuration.
Crash rollback/restart policy persistence is symbolic; actual server/commit/epoch evidence is required later.
Same-instance shared-superuser witness is an architectural countercondition, not a newly executed PostgreSQL attack.
Broken assumptions remain BOUNDARY_BREACH; STOP after detection does not undo a prior RX grant or mutation.
